title: Past narration
grammar: Past Continuous, Past Simple vs Past Continuous

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn to combine Past Simple and Past Continuous to tell stories with background and interruptions.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I was walking home when I saw an old friend. They were cooking dinner while we were watching TV. Notice: Past Continuous for background, Past Simple for interruption.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.explanation: Background action in Past Continuous, interruption in Past Simple.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write a short story (5 sentences) using Past Simple and Past Continuous.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: Background in Past Continuous, sudden event in Past Simple.
